TI datasheet package table lists TAS6584QPHDRQ1, HTQFP-64 PHD, reel of 1,000 - code and package confirmed, price neither confirmed nor contradicted.

Farnell DE (https://de.farnell.com/nxp/s32k342eht0mpbst/mcu-32-bit-160mhz-qfp-ep-172/dp/4134287) 100+ EUR 10,350 (= 10.35, German decimal; 1+ 13,880) - same as recorded. Farnell BE (https://be.farnell.com/fr-BE/nxp/s32k342eht0mpbst/mcu-32-bits-160mhz-qfp-ep-172/dp/4134287) 100+ EUR 10.18, within 2%. No Digi-Key/Mouser hit.

Digi-Key CH (https://www.digikey.ch/en/products/detail/u-blox/NEO-M9V-20B/16611140) 1 = CHF 13.79, 500 T&R CHF 11.27 ex VAT (~EUR 12.0) - within 3% of recorded EUR 12.29 @500. CAUTION: a different Digi-Key snapshot (digikey.ie, same product id) shows 1 = EUR 30.23 and ~EUR 19.30 @250, i.e. an older, much higher ladder; the researcher saw the same conflict. Price appears to have fallen; the lower current ladder (NL / CH agree) is the one recorded. Not AEC-Q (aecq false is right).

RS stock no. 222-4836 exists on many RS sites (TO-247-3, 1200 V 20 A SiC Schottky). RS UK (https://uk.rs-online.com/web/p/schottky-diodes-rectifiers/2224836) 1-9 GBP 6.04, 100+ GBP 4.89 ex VAT (~EUR 5.6) - the recorded RS DE 100+ EUR 6.89 is ~23% above that, just inside +/-25%. RS DE figure itself not seen. The RS UK GBP 4.89 @100 is the safer value if the merge prefers the lower. Configuration (single 20 A vs 2x10 A common cathode) not resolved.

RS 349-088 (https://it.rs-online.com/web/p/microcontroller/0349088; also BE-FR, PT): 1000+ EUR 4.81 ex VAT - matches recorded. Note RS SE shows 1000+ SEK 81.76 (~EUR 7.1) and RS JP 1000+ JPY 1,390 (~EUR 8), so RS regional prices disagree; EUR sites agree with each other. aecqCorrect false (low confidence): in the Cypress/Infineon ordering code the letter after 'AZ' is the temperature grade and 'E' is normally the automotive E-grade (-40 to 125 C, AEC-Q100); not confirmed by a search, so the aecq flag should be checked before the merge rather than left as false by default.
